title: Patch: Training Grounds' Legacy cards redrawn in the yard's own art style
notes: Each Training Grounds Legacy card (#41–#60) draws its Core card's subject in the set's training yard, with a touch of its own, on both faces (R2724000). How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Legacy cards get their own art
changes: Each Training Grounds Legacy card now has art of its own: its Core card's picture redrawn in the training yard, with a touch of its own.
